_comment: Override realm `platform-staging` di atas platform.json (deep-merge objek, list diganti). Hanya kunci top-level platform.json.

Per 2026-10-03 subset terkelola staging = prod (SELECT DB: setelan realm identik). Redirect URI/hostname client dan SMTP TIDAK termasuk subset terkelola Fase 1 (client control-plane/odoo-* dan smtpServer berisi secret dikelola di tempat lain).
Contoh pemakaian W2 (setelah uji S1 di staging): {"realm": {"organizationsEnabled": true}} — staging dulu, prod menyusul lewat platform.json.
